errors.chunkLoad: A part of the app could not be loaded. Reload the window to try again.
errors.INVALID_REQUEST: Some values are not valid. Check the fields and try again.
errors.INVALID_RESPONSE: The app received an unexpected answer. Try again.
errors.UNKNOWN_CHANNEL: The app tried to do something it does not support.
errors.NOT_FOUND: The requested item or folder was not found.
errors.ALREADY_EXISTS: This already exists, for example a library on the same folder.
errors.CONFLICT: The data was changed elsewhere in the meantime. Reload and try again.
errors.INVALID_PATH: This folder or file name is not valid.
errors.PATH_OUTSIDE_ROOT: This location is outside the library folder and was refused.
errors.IO_ERROR: The file could not be read or written. Check that the folder is available.
errors.SCHEMA_INVALID: A data file is not in the expected format.
errors.NOT_IMPLEMENTED: This feature is not available yet.
errors.PERMISSION_DENIED: Not allowed. Choose the folder or file again with the picker.
errors.FOLDER_NOT_AI_ENABLED: This folder is not enabled for sending to Claude.
errors.AI_BUDGET_EXCEEDED: The usage cap has been reached.
errors.AI_PROVIDER_ERROR: The AI provider returned an error.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: An online source could not be reached. Check the connection and try again.
errors.SECRET_UNAVAILABLE: Secure storage is not available on this computer, so keys cannot be saved.
errors.READ_ONLY: Your settings were saved by a newer version of the app, so they are read-only here. Update the app to change them.
errors.networkOffline: No connection: the online sources could not be reached. What was fetched before stays available offline.
errors.networkRateLimited: An online source asked to slow down (rate limit). Try again in a few minutes.
errors.networkHttp: An online source answered with an error. Try again later.
errors.networkTimeout: An online source did not answer in time. Try again in a moment.
errors.doiOwned: Another document of your library already has this DOI, so the published version was not applied.
errors.STOPPED: not tried: the sources before it kept failing
errors.PARTIAL: more works than one check reads: check again to continue
errors.OWN_AUTHOR_UNKNOWN: no OpenAlex author matches your profile: add your OpenAlex author id in Settings
errors.OPENALEX_KEY_REQUIRED: an OpenAlex API key is needed: add one in Settings
errors.AI_TOKEN_CAP_REACHED: Request not run: the monthly token cap is reached.

notices.settingsReset: Your settings file could not be used ({{reason}}), so the app restarted with default settings. The damaged file was kept as "{{backup}}" in the app data folder; libraries must be added again.
notices.backupFailed: The automatic backup did not run ({{code}}). Check the backup settings.
notices.settingsReadOnly: Your settings were saved by a newer version of the app (format {{found}}, this app understands {{supported}}). They are shown read-only and nothing will be changed. Update the app to edit them.

reason.invalid-schema: its content is not in the expected format

validation.defaultModel: Choose one of the models in the list.
validation.monthlyUsd: Enter a positive amount or leave it empty for no cap.
